items.rationale: The packet supports only the broader statement that the bounded set did not establish a controlled ablation of a claim-level evidence audit. It does not provide source-by-source findings or an excerpt establishing the claim's added same-backbone, same-task, same-budget, paired-design, and immediate-pre-delivery criteria, so the precise bounded novelty/gap assertion is not evidenced at the level claimed.
decisive_evidence: gap_statement: The bounded reviewed set does not establish, via controlled ablation, whether inserting a claim-level evidence audit into an end-to-end research agent reduces hallucinated experimental details and unsupported conclusions.
limitations: human full-text review is required before publication-grade novelty claims
